note: Printed words that name a control drawn directly above them, and how to locate that control on the current frame. This file holds IDENTITY and a RELATION, never a click position: 'template_path' is a picture of the control, matched on the frame in front of the run, and the tap target is wherever the match IS. Constitution A §24.2 forbids a stored coordinate as a tap target and §24.4 forbids reading a historical position to click; §24.3 explicitly allows a bounded search region, which is what 'search' records. A record may also carry 'allow_measured_block': true, which lets the measured-block gate run when no crop exists yet -- it is off by default because that gate failed its own calibration (see docs/LOCAL_PLANNER_ACCEPTANCE.md §7).
